papers.title_en: Request Order Matters: Cache-History Sensitivity in Selective KV-Cache Reuse for Rolling Agents
papers.authors: Tiffany Gu, Annie Guan, Manshu Huang, Nitin Rao, Siddhant Shah, Margaret Capetz
papers.evidence: 滚动智能体请求间的选择性KV缓存复用
papers.tldr: 面向滚动式智能体，长文档窗口反复增删导致精确前缀缓存失效，需用非前缀KV缓存复用与选择性重计算。论文发现此类复用存在缓存历史敏感性：同一提示因先前请求顺序不同而答案变化。提出按文档对齐的重计算策略，在5%预算下将跨请求顺序答案变异从69.0%降至26.1%。相对token top-k，对完整预填充的保真度提升34.5–52.5个百分点，并保持约5.7倍TTFT加速，指出连续性对稳健复用最关键。
papers.abstract_en: Long-running agents repeatedly call an LLM while retaining most of their document window, evicting old documents, and appending new ones. These rolling updates break exact prefix caching and motivate non-prefix KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation. We show that persistent KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation can be history-dependent: in our rolling-agent workload, an unchanged prompt can produce different answers depending on the requests processed before it. At a matched 5% recomputation budget, document-aligned recomputation reduces answer variation across request orders from 69.0% with CacheBlend's token top-$k$ policy to 26.1%. When each prompt is evaluated after a different sequence of preceding requests, document-aligned recomputation improves fidelity to full prefill by 34.5-52.5 percentage points over token top-$k$, while both policies achieve approximately 5.7$\times$ median TTFT speedup. Our ablation study shows that, in our rolling-agent workload, contiguity is the main factor associated with robust selective recomputation.

papers.title_en: Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.authors: Jiaqi Zhao, Haodong Chen, Jitai Hao, Wei Zhao, Jinghao Pang, Qiang Huang, Jun Yu
papers.evidence: 连接智能体外壳与KV缓存状态的工作流感知服务
papers.tldr: 现有LLM agent服务中，harness与推理引擎信息割裂，难以工作流感知地高效协同。本文提出HEAR双向配对协议，标准化工作流意图、执行需求与引擎运行时状态、能力及结果交换，并解耦协议语义与优化策略。在四个基准上，SCBench批处理加速1.61倍、首token中位延迟降2.23倍，BrowseComp-Plus与DeepResearchBench端到端加速1.23倍和2.45倍且质量不降。HEAR为agentic LLM serving提供可复用协调基座。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly execute complex workflows involving multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and parallel agents. Efficient serving requires decisions that span two layers with complementary information: the agent harness understands workflow dependencies, context lifecycles, and execution objectives, whereas the inference engine observes request queues, KV-cache state, resource pressure, and execution capabilities. Existing interfaces do not systematically connect these views, limiting workflow-aware execution.   HEAR, a bidirectional Harness--Engine Pairing protocol for agentic LLM serving. HEAR standardizes how the harness communicates workflow intent and execution requirements and how the engine returns runtime state, capabilities, and outcomes. By separating protocol semantics from optimization policies, HEAR supports diverse coordination strategies without changing workflow or model semantics. We instantiate HEAR for online cache-aware runtime coordination and workload-aware execution-mode selection for agent roles.   Across four conversational and research-agent benchmarks under memory-constrained, concurrent serving, HEAR achieves a $1.61\times$ batch speedup and reduces median time-to-first-token by $2.23\times$ on SCBench. Mooncake shows that workflow intent and live engine state provide complementary benefits across load regimes. On BrowseComp-Plus and DeepResearchBench, workload-specific configurations yield $1.23\times$ and $2.45\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, without observed task-quality degradation. These results establish HEAR as a reusable coordination substrate for efficient agentic LLM serving.

papers.title_en: Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference: What It Costs, What It Buys, and When You Can Tell
papers.authors: Hochan Son, Kyungdoe Han, Jaehan Koh, Xiaowu Dai, Wenlu Xu, Guang Cheng
papers.evidence: 跨协作智能体分解推理以约束KV缓存，并设持久层复用推理轨迹
papers.tldr: 长上下文推理可分解到多智能体，以限制单次调用 KV 缓存峰值；许多系统再加持久记忆层存储推理轨迹，并以消融准确率增益验证。本文在同一三层智能体架构上测量成本与收益：分解使每查询峰值 KV 工作集降至 14.3 MiB，低于单遍与检索增强的约 35.5 MiB。持久层则增加 0.368 MiB 峰值缓存，未带来可检测准确率变化。作者认为该零结果是结构性的，并给出记忆消融应满足的条件与检测流程。
papers.abstract_en: Decomposing long-context inference across cooperating agents bounds the active KV cache per call rather than total evidence, which matters when KV-cache memory binds. Many such systems add a persistent tier storing and recalling reasoning traces, usually validated by an ablation reporting an accuracy gain. We measure both on one three-tier agent architecture. Decomposition delivers: peak KV working set of 14.3 MiB per query against 35.5 and 35.3 MiB for single-pass and retrieval-augmented baselines. The persistent tier does not: across eight controlled dataset pairs at n=100 per arm it costs +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] of peak cache and produces no detectable accuracy change (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]). We argue the null is structural: single-question benchmarks supply each item with its own evidence and score it independently, and correctness requires resetting stored traces between conditions, so recall has nothing informative to retrieve. Reaching it took four measurement corrections -- three inflating the apparent benefit, the fourth making an effect that size look resolvable -- none visible in the results table. We give the conditions an agent-memory ablation must satisfy and detection procedures that need no knowledge of the specific defect.

papers.title_en: Lachesis: Lifetime-Aware KV Cache Placement for Agent Serving across HBM and High-Bandwidth Flash
papers.authors: Jaehoon Yang, Jeongmin Lee, Haneul Park, Seung Yul Lee, Nam Sung Kim, Jae W. Lee
papers.evidence: 面向智能体服务的寿命感知KV缓存放置与调度
papers.tldr: LLM 智能体服务中，agent 及其子 agent 跨请求累积 KV cache，占用大量内存。高带宽闪存 HBF 容量大一个数量级、读带宽接近 HBM，但写入寿命有限是核心瓶颈。Lachesis 在 agent harness 与服务引擎之间做生命周期感知的 KV cache 放置：写入时按段生命周期选 HBM 或 HBF，段不再被读时释放其块。轨迹仿真中 HBF 寿命提升 1.19-3.13 倍，达 3.3-12.2 设备年。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly dominated by agentic workloads, in which agents and their sub-agents accumulate context as KV cache across many requests, consuming substantial memory. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) is a promising solution, providing an order of magnitude greater capacity at HBM-class read bandwidth, but its finite write endurance is the key limiting factor. Our key insight is that KV cache should be placed across HBM and HBF by its lifetime. Placing shorter-lived data in HBM lets HBM absorb more of an agent run's writes and sends less of them to HBF. As the lifetime of KV cache in agentic serving is dictated by the harness, the program that orchestrates the agents, we analyze its behavior and identify three axes along which lifetime diverges, temporal, structural, and inter-worker. Guided by these observations, we present Lachesis, a lifetime-aware KV cache placement layer between the agent harness and the serving engine. At write time, it places each segment in HBM or HBF according to its lifetime, and frees its blocks once the segment is no longer read. In trace-driven simulation, Lachesis extends HBF lifetime by 1.19-3.13x over HBM-first placement, reaching 3.3-12.2 device-years. Even under continuous 24x7 operation at the full load a tight SLO admits, HBF outlasts its five-year warranty on the multi-agent trace.

papers.title_en: SnapShare: Isolation-Preserving Deduplication for Serverless Snapshots
papers.authors: Leonid Kondrashov, Likun Zhang, André Filipe do Pilar de Jesus, Hans Pistor, Marco Cali, Riccardo Mancini, Rodrigo Bruno, Dmitrii Ustiugov
papers.evidence: 无服务器快照去重降低冷启动时延与浪费的每工作节点缓存
papers.tldr: 无服务器计算依赖虚拟机快照恢复实现快速启动，但内容去重会引入时序侧信道攻击，导致生产平台对跨租户快照实施严格零共享隔离。SnapShare 通过仅将完整内容与提供方批准源匹配的页标记为可共享，实现集群级选择性去重与缓存协同，公共基础设施被去重并固定在各工作节点，私有数据保持严格隔离。在 Knative 上实现后，尾请求延迟降低 10-29%，远程存储需求减少 39%，本地缓存占用减少 38%，网络取回负载与最坏取回延迟均降低 10 倍。
papers.abstract_en: The efficiency of serverless computing fundamentally depends on rapid function startup, a challenge increasingly addressed by restoring from virtual machine snapshots. However, because content deduplication techniques can open timing-channel attacks that leak sensitive tenant data, production platforms like AWS Lambda instead enforce strict, zero-sharing isolation between snapshots of different tenants. While secure, this isolation precludes the deduplication of common infrastructure components, wasting per-worker cache capacity and exacerbating cold-start latency through inefficient remote fetching. Our characterization reveals that non-sensitive, shareable infrastructure accounts for roughly 70% of a typical snapshot's contents and, on average, about 50% of its working set.   We present SnapShare, a cluster-wide snapshot management system that co-designs storage and caching to exploit this commonality without compromising sensitive data isolation. SnapShare classifies a snapshot page as shareable only when its full content matches that of a page from a provider-approved source; any non-matching content is treated as isolated private content. Common infrastructure components are selectively deduplicated and pinned across the cluster's worker nodes, while private data remains strictly isolated and is eagerly fetched as part of the tracked working set, falling back to on-demand retrieval only for pages that fall outside it. Implemented as an extension to Knative, SnapShare reduces end-to-end tail request slowdowns by 10-29% compared to traditional working-set and chunk-based platforms. It also reduces remote storage requirements by 39% and local cache footprints by 38%, reducing network retrieval payloads and bounding worst-case fetch delays by 10x.

papers.title_en: Serve Now or Improve Later? Scheduling Self-Evolution in Online Agent Systems
papers.authors: Yangbo Wei, Junhong Qian, Zhen Huang, Zhenyu Su, Qifan Wang, Shaoqiang Lu, Rumin Zhang, Chen Wu, Lei He
papers.evidence: 智能体系统中能力复用窗口与计算恢复的调度
papers.tldr: 在线智能体可利用闲置GPU自进化以提升未来服务，但收益依赖产物发布后被使用，暂停还会带来显存释放与恢复开销。LearnSched将能力复用窗口与算力归还纳入统一投资模型，结合候选进度、检查点开销和恢复路径，用一步反事实rollout选择继续、检查点或等待。在1920个配对有限模型场景中，冷恢复昂贵时等待更长执行窗口可避免交接并提升净价值，暖恢复下强窗口策略已同等。保留可恢复状态可加速容量归还并简化进化调度。
papers.abstract_en: Online agents can improve future service by constructing reusable tools, guidance, or model states, but this work competes with current requests for the same GPUs. Exploiting idle compute for self-evolution faces a fundamental systems constraint: benefits arrive only after an artifact is published and used, while pausing evolution leaves service capacity waiting for memory release and runtime recovery. An investment worth completing may therefore be worth postponing. We present LearnSched, a state-aware scheduler that brings the reuse window of a capability and the timely return of compute into a common investment model. LearnSched incorporates candidate progress, checkpoint overhead, and the current recovery path into action values. Under the same information and capacity constraints, it uses one-step counterfactual rollout to choose progress, checkpointing, or waiting relative to a fully costed window policy. We characterize handoff costs through independent A100 component measurements and evaluate action selection in 1920 paired finite-model scenarios. When cold recovery is expensive, waiting for longer execution windows can improve net value by avoiding handoffs; in evaluated warm-recovery scenarios, the strong window policy already achieves the same value. Retaining recoverable state can shorten capacity return and reduce the need for complex evolution scheduling.

papers.title_en: Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN
papers.authors: Zhongqin Wang, Xiaoqi Zhang, Nan Yang, Kai Wu, J. Andrew Zhang, Y. Jay Guo
papers.evidence: 借助KV缓存跨配置复用历史状态，避免重复处理完整历史
papers.tldr: 现有语义感知多为开环，配置与观测调度在推理前固定，无法随任务证据动态调整。本文提出Agentic SemS闭环框架，在通信可行剖面集合内控制感知：用剖面条件因果Transformer维护语义信念，并通过键值缓存高效更新状态，语义效用网络估计下一观测块收益。实验表明，资源高效设置相较全序列High降低25.33%归一化累积感知成本，仍达85.79% Macro-F1；语义早退在相同效用点再降12.35%成本，Macro-F1仅降0.97个百分点。该工作为AI-RAN提供价值信息驱动的自适应语义感知方案。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.

papers.title_en: ShoreKeeper: Accelerating Iterative Data Analytics in the Cloud via Distributed Recovery-Cost-Aware Caching
papers.authors: Jongseop Lee, Minsu Sun, Xinyue Ma, Atul Sandur, Myeongjae Jeon
papers.evidence: 跨节点统一内存池中最小化驱逐恢复代价的缓存管理
papers.tldr: 迭代图计算与机器学习会持续产生中间数据，内存需求巨大；现有缓存局限于单节点且假设节点高可用，难以适应云上抢占式实例。ShoreKeeper 将集群内存视为统一弹性池，把分布式数据流映射为单图并全局优化，以最小化跨集群缓存驱逐后的恢复成本；还通过图剪枝快速调整缓存计划。实验表明它持续优于现有系统，可在高可用VM与低成本可抢占实例上高效运行。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale data-intensive workloads powered by iterative graph or machine learning processing have an insatiable demand for memory due to the continuous generation of new intermediate data. Although existing caching strategies strive to keep performance-critical data in memory, they often fail in practice because they are limited to node-local memory management and assume high node availability. In this paper, we introduce ShoreKeeper, a framework that maximizes execution efficiency by treating cluster-wide memory as a unified, elastic pool. ShoreKeeper employs a global optimization model that maps distributed dataflows into a single graph abstraction to minimize the recovery cost of data evicted from cache across the cluster. To handle memory working sets and cluster capacities that fluctuate over time, ShoreKeeper employs a graph-pruning technique that permits the fast refinement of the caching plan. These optimizations allow ShoreKeeper to work seamlessly whether deployed on highly available VMs or cost-effective preemptible instances in the cloud. Our experiments show that ShoreKeeper consistently outperforms state-of-the-art systems.
